scripts.dev: concurrently -n identity,civil-registry,health,benefits,notifications,portal -c blue,green,yellow,magenta,white,cyan "npm run dev -w @simdpg/identity" "npm run dev -w @simdpg/civil-registry" "npm run dev -w @simdpg/health" "npm run dev -w @simdpg/benefits" "npm run dev -w @simdpg/notifications" "npm run dev -w portal"
scripts.dev:services: concurrently -n identity,civil-registry,health,benefits,notifications -c blue,green,yellow,magenta,white "npm run dev -w @simdpg/identity" "npm run dev -w @simdpg/civil-registry" "npm run dev -w @simdpg/health" "npm run dev -w @simdpg/benefits" "npm run dev -w @simdpg/notifications"
scripts.reset: rm -f services/identity/data/*.sqlite* services/civil-registry/data/*.sqlite* services/health/data/*.sqlite* services/benefits/data/*.sqlite* services/notifications/data/*.sqlite* && echo 'All databases deleted. If services are running, restart them (npm run dev:services).'
scripts.setup: npm run db:seed -w @simdpg/identity && npm run db:seed -w @simdpg/civil-registry && npm run db:seed -w @simdpg/health && npm run db:seed -w @simdpg/benefits && npm run db:seed -w @simdpg/notifications && echo 'All services seeded.'
scripts.setup:generate: node scripts/check-services.js && npm run build -w @simdpg/api-clients && npm run sim:generate -w @simdpg/simulation
